---
title: "Synthetic Musings"
listing:
  # Only a post's entry file is a listing item. Anything else in a post's folder
  # (a slide deck, posts/<slug>/slides.qmd) is reached from the post itself.
  # The leading / anchors the glob at the project root; unanchored, it also
  # matched the posts of a git worktree checked out inside the repo (wt-*/).
  contents:
    - "/posts/*/index.qmd"
    - "/posts/*/index.ipynb"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: table
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [image, date, title, description, reading-time]
  feed: true
  page-size: 40
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---

Unfiltered technical write-ups, model implementation notes, and practical machine
